# History Hit

> > History Hit is a comprehensive historical resource covering military conflicts, ancient civilizations, political figures, and pivotal moments from ancient Rome to modern warfare.

History Hit provides in-depth articles and analysis on major historical events, with particular focus on World War One, World War Two, ancient empires, and influential leaders like Winston Churchill and Napoleon. The site features expert commentary from historians including Dan Snow, covering topics from the Western Front to the Pacific Theater.

## Key Topics

- World War One
- World War Two
- Military History
- Naval Warfare
- Aviation History
- Winston Churchill
- Western Front
- Britain
- Ancient Rome
- Napoleon Bonaparte
- Battle of Midway
- Holocaust
- Israel-Palestine Conflict
- Alexander the Great
- Anglo-Saxon England

## World War One

- [10 Facts About the Build-Up to World War One](https://www.historyhit.com/facts-about-the-build-up-to-world-war-one): WWI buildup: Triple Alliance, Triple Entente & European tensions
- [10 Facts About Archduke Franz Ferdinand](https://www.historyhit.com/facts-about-archduke-franz-ferdinand): Archduke Franz Ferdinand assassination & WWI causes in Sarajevo
- [Who Was the Red Baron? The Most Famous Fighter Ace of World War One](https://www.historyhit.com/who-was-the-red-baron-the-most-famous-fighter-ace-of-world-war-one): Manfred von Richthofen: WWI's most famous fighter ace & aviator
- [10 Facts About Submarine Warfare in World War One](https://www.historyhit.com/facts-about-submarine-warfare-in-world-war-one): WWI submarine warfare: German U-boats & naval tactics evolution
- [How One British Regiment's Heroic Resistance Saved the First Battle of Ypres…Twice!](https://www.historyhit.com/day-first-battle-ypres-begins): First Battle of Ypres 1914: Worcester Regiment heroic resistance
- [The Great War in Words: 20 Quotes by Contemporaries of World War One](https://www.historyhit.com/the-great-war-in-words-quotes-by-contemporaries-of-world-war-one): WWI quotes from contemporaries & wartime perspectives collection

## World War Two

- [Where Did the Battle of Midway Take Place and What Was Its Significance?](https://www.historyhit.com/where-did-the-battle-of-midway-take-place-and-what-was-its-significance): WWII Battle of Midway significance in Pacific Theater naval warfare
- [Why Do People Deny the Holocaust?](https://www.historyhit.com/why-do-people-deny-the-holocaust): Holocaust denial, antisemitism & historical revisionism explained
- [How Greece Tore Itself Apart in a Vicious Civil War at the End of World War Two](https://www.historyhit.com/how-greece-tore-itself-apart-in-a-vicious-civil-war-at-the-end-of-world-war-two): Greek Civil War 1944: British-backed Royalists vs Communist forces
- [HMS Ark Royal and the Ascendancy of Aircraft in Naval Warfare](https://www.historyhit.com/1941-sinking-ark-royal): HMS Ark Royal sinking 1941 & aircraft carrier naval warfare rise
